task_completion.description: Increase the Reserved Space on the primary storage location to 30 GB.

task_completion.description: Set the Backup Bandwidth Limit to 15 Mbps.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target Backup Bandwidth Limit is 15 Mbps (15,000,000 bps). The target Reserved Space is 30 GiB, which is exactly 32,212,254,720 bytes; in the UI, this may appear as '30 GB' or '32,212 MB'. Acceptable tolerances are ±10% for bandwidth and ±5% for storage.
